newsitem.title: USA: FPA Medical sets $100 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: FPA Medical sets $100 mln shr offer.

text.p: FPA Medical Management Inc on Tuesday said it plans to register for the sale of $100 million of its common stock in a public offering.
In a statement, the company said a portion of the shares will be sold by current stockholders, but an exact amount has yet to be determined.

Earlier, the company said it earned $0.14 a share on revenue of $77.8 million in the third quarter ended September 30, versus a profit of $0.05 a share on $12.5 million in revenue one year ago. Share figures reflect a two-for-one stock split in April 1995.

During the quarter FPA Medical, a health care management provider, added 200 physicians and more than 40,000 patients to its networks. Currently the company is affiliated with over 2,800 doctors serving more than 370,000 patients.

FPA Medical said the board of directors of Sterling Healthcare Group Inc, which FPA Medical is acquiring, approved an exchange ratio of .951 FPA Medical share for every Sterling share based on an FPA price of $24.1958.
Shareholder meetings of FPA Medical and and Sterling Healthcare are scheduled for October 31.
